proposals.evidence: DEDR 1479 full article (p. 138) gives 1479 Ta. kāl leg, foot, base (of tree), quarter, family, relationship; kālāḷ footsoldier; kāli herd of cows, cow. Ma. kāl leg, foot, stem, pillar, quarter; kālāḷ foot-soldier; kāli cow, catt Bhat kārɨ “leg” matches Lindgren Koraga kārɨ “foot or leg” in form and sense; this cross-source match is a candidate lead, with the full DEDR article defining the family. Both source identities and dialect tags are preserved.
